fix(platform-resources): finalize OSS uploads and load shell icons (#305)

* fix(platform-resources): finalize OSS uploads and load shell icons

Relax platform resource upload finalize when OSS omits optional metadata,
read sha256 user meta case-insensitively, and bump orion for platform file
fallback used by Breeze shell glyph aliases.

* fix(platform-resources): verify uploaded bytes before finalize

Read the pending OSS object and recompute sha256 during finalize instead
of trusting optional object metadata alone.
